blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senators on Thursday spoke to the leaders of Japan on removing tariffs of Philippine products during a parliamentary visit, in light of the 70th Philippines-Japan Friendship Anniversary. Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian led the Philippine delegation joined by Senate Majority Leader Juan Miguel Zubiri, Deputy Majority Leader JV Ejercito, Sens. Erwin Tulfo, Lito Lapid and Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan. In a series of meetings, the senators sat down with Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae, former Prime Minister Kishida Fumio, Senate President Sekiguchi Masakazu, House of Representatives Speaker Mori Eisuke and other lawmakers. “Nagkaroon tayo ng isang produktibong pakikipagpulong sa ating […]...
